name: Morb
subtitle: Studio sound for voice & video
oneLiner: Make a phone recording sound studio-made in one tap. Clean up hum, lift your voice, pick a sound, share.
spotlightTitle: Morb makes a phone recording sound studio-made.
description: Turn a raw cover video into a studio-quality take. Pick one of four sounds, set reverb and loudness, and your first three exports are free.

feature.title: Morb makes a phone recording sound studio-made.
feature.body: Open a cover video you shot on your phone, pick a sound, and Morb cleans up the hum and lifts your voice. Trim it, pick a frame, and share it straight to Reels or Shorts.

rows.title: Trim it and choose a frame

reviews.text: Being able to hear the changes before exporting is great. Makes finding the right sound so much easier.
I want to sing but I’m not sure how to edit. This is really helpful.
Does what it says, simple app.

scene.alt: An iPhone on a desk at night showing Morb’s Enhance screen, with sound presets and reverb and loudness sliders, next to headphones, a lamp and a to-do list
